how: node next/bench-195.ts --runs=5 --patches=40, Rolldown 1.2.13 and oxc-transform-react 0.156.0, React production build, headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64.1), cross-origin isolated page. Renders are per moment (10 focus moves, 40 patches, 10 presses). ms is per commit, from the store's first notify to React's commit hook. perTile and tileShell are dropped from each run to keep the file small; totals stay.
